chapter: Zue Robertson, Bakke family and teachers
title: How good Picou and his contemporaries were
summary: Barnes says it was hard to choose among Picou, Baquet and the other clarinetists, all solid men.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: I only heard him in late years, and he sounded very good, I thought. Was he considered one of the very best, or were some others better than him? What do you think? Say 40 years ago, how was Pico?

Well, during that time, it was hard to tell between Rocky, and Pico, and TU, and Charlie. Charlie and the Curtis. Yeah, it was hard to tell, because all those men was good. You know, now maybe it comes to a test, we could find it out. Yeah. I know in them days it was good. Because Pico was good, George was good, all of them was solid men.
